title: PhysxConvexDecompositionCollisionAPI
summary: Convex decomposition cooking parameters for a Mesh collider with physics:approximation convexDecomposition. Cooking inputs only; nothing here is verified. Two schema fallbacks differ from the consumer's absent-column seeds.
producer_scope: Every declared attribute of an applied collision API is published at its resolved value; all six columns land as their raw fallbacks when unauthored. No derivation.

columns.name: physxConvexDecompositionCollision:maxConvexHulls
columns.absent: 16, the cooking default. The USD schema fallback is 32 and the producer publishes it, so a hand-populated stage that omits the column decomposes into at most half as many hulls as USD population.

columns.name: physxConvexDecompositionCollision:hullVertexLimit
columns.absent: 64, the cooking default, unless the free attribute newton:maxHullVertices is present with a value > 0, which then supplies the limit.

columns.name: physxConvexDecompositionCollision:voxelResolution
columns.absent: 100000, the cooking default. The USD schema fallback is 500000 and the producer publishes it, so a hand-populated stage that omits the column voxelises five times coarser than USD population.

columns.name: physxConvexDecompositionCollision:shrinkWrap
columns.absent: false: hull points are not projected back onto the source surface.

interactions.rule: Read only when the descriptor kind is convexDecomposition. Unlike PhysxConvexHullCollisionAPI there is no usd-schemas gate: the six columns are read whenever they exist on the collider, so free attributes authored without applying the API are honoured.

findings.summary: Absent column seeds 16, the runtime's default cooked hull count, while the USD schema fallback published by the producer is 32. Only a hand-populated stage that omits the column is affected; it is a cooking input, not a PhysX default, so the divergence changes the cooked hull count rather than a PhysX object field.
Absent column seeds the cooking default 100000 while the USD schema fallback published by the producer is 500000. Same class as maxConvexHulls.

notes: Cooking APIs on a Mesh cannot be verified by the generated tests: the parameters are consumed by the cooking service and PhysX exposes no getter for them, and the builder writes no mesh arrays.
